Now I have enough to identify the handler names that broadcast SSE events, either directly or via the shared `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` helper (used by `UpdateMemo`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations`).

q20. Mechanism: Server-Sent Events (SSE) — a persistent one-way HTTP stream pushed from server to browser, not WebSockets. Client connections are managed by an in-memory `SSEHub` with per-client buffered channels, filtered by visibility/creator on broadcast (`canReceive` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`).

Hub path: `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (types `SSEHub`, `SSEClient`, `SSEEvent`, methods `Subscribe`/`Unsubscribe`/`Broadcast`/`Close`), with the HTTP stream endpoint in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` and event-construction helpers in `server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go`.

Memo/reaction handlers that broadcast through `s.SSEHub.Broadcast(...)`:
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:163`
- `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:585`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:126`
- `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:71`) — shared broadcast helper invoked by `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:513`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:48`), and `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:48`)
- `UpsertMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:106`
- `DeleteMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:161`
